instruction: Cinematic over-the-shoulder medium close-up in an indoor judo dojo with a landscape mural. On the left, the young woman with her hair in a bun (R1) bows forward in her blue judo gi, looking down respectfully. In the foreground right, the older man in a white judo gi (R3) is seen from behind, out of focus, facing her. Bright, soft natural light illuminates the scene, creating a respectful atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
